_comment: Where each bot's backtested equity curve comes from. Paths are relative to dashboard/.
Each csv needs a date-like first column and an 'equity' column.
The hero line's return is the percentage the card counts up to.
A second, non-hero line is how you show a filter's contribution honestly: same
signals and same period, one filtered and one not.
Put a 'caveat' on any result that does not generalise. It prints on the card itself.

orb.note: Same breakouts in both lines. The lower one takes every signal; the upper one takes only those the filter approved.
